title: From Forest to Fiber: Giving Customers a Firsthand Look at Sustainable Packaging
body_markdown: Scott Sauer leads Growth Marketing at International Paper, a team he helped launch in 2024 to accelerate customer acquisition, retention, and business growth. Since joining International Paper in 2010, Scott has held communications and marketing roles supporting the International Paper Foundation, the Packaging Solutions business, and the company's mill and box plant systems.
